'''Chris Hill''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Wizard World King of Corellia]] on 18 August 2001 with [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|RST Boomrace]], according to Bradley Augsburger's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2883">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-22-wizardworld-done-wrong-aka-my-head-hurtsd2883/ wizardworld-done-wrong-aka-my-head-hurts], DeckTech (Bradley "BadBrad" Augsburger, 22 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-22-wizardworld-done-wrong-aka-my-head-hurtsd2883/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
